page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores, resulting in 1.0 thread per core. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. The lack of hyperthreading ensures dedicated physical execution resources per vCPU, which eliminates resource contention between threads but limits the total concurrent thread count compared to hyperthreaded configurations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r8i.2xlarge offers a high-density memory configuration relative to its compute resources, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing tasks.
